records.interpretation: The source-level authority withdrawal is delivered locally but does not propagate as a durable annotation, while pre-existing shared carriers and semantic descendants remain usable. This supports a structure-supported persistence hypothesis but does not prove that information drive has been fully replaced by structure.

records.interpretation: The experiment-origin unconfirmed annotation remains local while the pre-existing shared container/value remains directly available and reused downstream. Under v5 this is best represented as source/pool-status decoupling with candidate stable-pool support, not as proof that the source proposition was independently reconfirmed.
records.boundary: Container-level status=fact cannot be promoted to nested proposition-level authority.
